svg.title: Monthly commits — an ink mountain landscape
svg.desc: 1,417 fictional commits across 269 active days, from 2025-10-26 to 2026-10-24. Main mountain height grows with squared monthly commits. Each date, count, and daily calendar travels with its mountain. Fainter cragged peaks use the same drawing at different depths. Brushwork trees, mist, reflections and river life are decorative. A fish jumps at a different spot every 7.5 seconds. The seamless scene repeats every 180 seconds. Reduced motion is supported.
svg.text: Monthly commits · taller peaks, busier months
